macros.name: texdimenbothbpmm
macros.doc: Produces a decimal (with up to five decimal places) D such that Dmm is the largest dimension smaller (in absolute value) than the original one and exactly representable both in the bp and mm units.

macros.name: texdimenbothbpmmpt
macros.doc: Produces a decimal (with up to five decimal places) D such that Dpt is the largest dimension not exceeding the original one and exactly representable both in the bp and mm units.

macros.name: texdimenbothbpmmsp
macros.doc: Produces an integer (explicit digit tokens) N such that Nsp is the largest dimension not exceeding the original one and exactly representable both in the bp and mm units.

macros.name: texdimenbothcminpt
macros.doc: Produces a decimal (with up to five decimal places) D such that Dpt is the largest dimension not exceeding the original one (in absolute value) and exactly representable both in the in and cm units.

macros.name: texdimenbothcminsp
macros.doc: Produces an integer (explicit digit tokens) N such that Nsp is the largest dimension not exceeding the original one in absolute value and exactly representable both in the in and cm units.

macros.name: texdimenbothincm
macros.doc: \texdimenbothincm, respectively \texdimenbothbpmm, find the largest (in absolute value) dimension not exceeding the input and exactly representable both with the in and cm units, respectively exactly representable both with the bp and mm units.

macros.name: texdimenbothmmbp
macros.doc: Produces a decimal (with up to five decimal places) D such that Dbp is the largest dimension smaller (in absolute value) than the original one and exactly representable both in the bp and mm units.

macros.name: texdimenbp
macros.doc: \texdimenbp takes on input some dimension or dimension expression and produces on output a decimal D such that D bp is guaranteed to be the same dimension as the input, if it admits any representation as E bp; else it will be either the closest match from above or from below.

macros.name: texdimenbpdown
macros.doc: Produces a decimal (with up to five decimal places) D such that Dbp represents the dimension exactly if possible. If not possible it will be smaller by 1sp from the original dimension.

macros.name: texdimenbpup
macros.doc: Produces a decimal (with up to five decimal places) D such that Dbp represents the dimension exactly if possible. If not possible it will be larger by 1sp from the original dimension.

macros.name: texdimencc
macros.doc: Produces a decimal (with up to five decimal places) D such that Dcc represents the dimension exactly if possible. If not possible it will either be the closest from below or from above, but it is not known in advance which one (and it is not known if the other choice would have been closer).

macros.name: texdimenccdown
macros.doc: Produces a decimal (with up to five decimal places) D such that Dcc represents the dimension exactly if possible. If not possible it will be largest representable dimension smaller than the original one.

macros.name: texdimenccup
macros.doc: Produces a decimal (with up to five decimal places) D such that Dcc represents the dimension exactly if possible. If not possible it will be smallest representable dimension larger than the original one.

macros.name: texdimencm

macros.name: texdimenwithunit
macros.doc: \texdimenwithunit{<dimen1>}{<dimen2>} produces a decimal D such that D \dimexpr dimen2\relax is parsed by TeX into the same dimension as dimen1 if this is at all possible.
